description: The file is a shell script for testing Git commands related to committing files using --pathspec-from-file and related options. It contains setup, test cases, and verification steps to ensure correct behavior of pathspec handling in Git commits.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the repository state to a previous checkpoint using git reset --soft.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Verifies the files committed match the expected output by comparing Git diff with expected output.
